# Security Policy

LinuxFiles is an unofficial, community-maintained Linux port of [Files](https://github.com/files-community/Files). It is in alpha, and only the latest release and the `linux/main` branch receive fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability in LinuxFiles

Please report security issues in the Linux port privately through this fork's GitHub Security Advisories:
<https://github.com/MemerGamer/LinuxFiles/security/advisories/new>

Do not open a public issue for a vulnerability. Include the version or commit, your distribution, and steps to reproduce.

## Vulnerabilities that also affect upstream

If the problem is in code shared with upstream and is reproducible in the official Windows app, also report it to the Files Community through the upstream project's own security channel. Do not report LinuxFiles-specific problems upstream.
